scope: Offline preparation of one original synthetic onset-silence control; no Spotify, UI, audio-device, playback, recording, or subscription access.

construction.notes: The derived five-second file includes the first four seconds of the canonical signal after one second of source silence. It intentionally omits the original final second by construction; relay tests must use this derived reference, not claim coverage of all original canonical frames.

verification.method: Python wave read/write plus independent RIFF chunk parsing and complete packed signed24 sample decoding; fixed indices, no trimming, rounding, gain fit, alignment search, or resampling.

interpretationLimits: This fixture tests whether gain processing settles during one second of source silence; it does not repair or certify arbitrary non-silent openings.
The measured beta.3 exponential onset model covers only 512 frames. Continued behavior or a later unity-gain clamp is not established by that evidence.

Capture pre-roll silence is indistinguishable from identical source-leading silence without an independently observed source-start boundary; sample matching alone cannot prove all 44100 silent source frames were delivered.
An exact active suffix certifies only the complete 176400-frame active sequence at the observed software boundary, not the USB receiver or the subscription catalog.
A same-file replay pass is a separate conditional observation and cannot replace a failed first-start result.
